factCards.text: Tetris was written in 1984 by Alexey Pajitnov, a researcher at the Computing Centre of the Soviet Academy of Sciences in Moscow.
Atari takes its name from a term in Go, used when a group of stones is one move away from being captured.
The Konami Code — up, up, down, down, left, right, left, right, B, A — is credited to programmer Kazuhisa Hashimoto, who added it while porting Gradius to the Nintendo Entertainment System.
